name: Bite
description: A vicious bite that tears flesh. On a Strong or Critical hit, the target is Bleeding (2).

name: Claw Swipe
description: A raking strike with sharp claws.

name: Tail Sweep
description: A sweeping tail strike targeting all creatures in reach. Targets must succeed on a medium Agility + Athletics test or be knocked Prone.

name: Gore
description: A charge with horns or tusks. On a Critical hit, the target is Grappled.

name: Stomp
description: A crushing stomp against a prone or smaller creature.

name: Sword Strike
description: A direct strike with a sword.

name: Spear Thrust
description: A thrusting attack with a spear that can be made at close range.

name: Arrow Shot
description: A ranged attack with a bow.

name: Dagger Stab
description: A quick stab with a dagger. On a Strong or Critical hit, the target is Bleeding (1).

name: Poison Sting
description: A venomous sting. On a Strong or Critical hit, the target is Poisoned.

name: Venomous Bite
description: A bite that injects venom. On a Critical hit, the target is Poisoned and takes an additional 4 poison damage at the start of their next turn.

name: Fire Breath
description: Exhales a cone of flame targeting all creatures in a medium area in front of the creature. Affected targets may roll Agility + Athletics (TN 10) to halve the damage.

name: Frost Breath
description: Exhales a blast of freezing air in a medium area. On a Strong or Critical hit, targets are Slowed. Affected targets may roll Agility + Athletics (TN 10) to halve the damage.

name: Thunder Slam
description: Slams the ground with tremendous force, releasing a shockwave. All creatures within a close distance must succeed on a medium Strength + Fortitude test or be knocked Prone.
